ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the oath by the dawn in Surah Al-Fajr?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this opening oath by the dawn (Al-Fajr) is often interpreted as a reference to the dawn of prophethood or the emergence of Imam Ali at the dawn of Islam, symbolizing the dispelling of spiritual darkness. It establishes a thematic link between cosmic order and divine justice, setting the stage for the subsequent narratives of past civilizations' destruction as a warning for the present. This verse underscores the concept of 'Nur' (Light) as a central motif in Shia theology, connecting the physical dawn to the spiritual illumination of the Ahl al-Bayt.
